description: This file implements the CfAudioDeviceModule class, which provides an interface for audio device management and data handling within a WebRTC streaming context. It includes methods for audio data retrieval, device enumeration, device selection, initialization, control, and status querying, tailored for a Cuttlefish environment.

classes.name: CfAudioDeviceModule
classes.description: A class managing audio device operations, including data retrieval, device enumeration, configuration, and control for WebRTC streaming.

methods.name: GetMoreAudioData
methods.description: Retrieves additional audio data for playback, considering mute state and invoking the audio callback.

methods.name: ActiveAudioLayer
methods.description: Returns the active audio layer; currently returns -1 indicating no specific layer.

methods.name: RegisterAudioCallback
methods.description: Registers an external audio transport callback for full-duplex PCM audio transportation.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the audio device module; currently a no-op returning success.

methods.name: Terminate
methods.description: Terminates the audio device module; currently a no-op returning success.

methods.name: PlayoutDevices
methods.description: Returns the number of playout devices; fixed to 1.

methods.name: RecordingDevices
methods.description: Returns the number of recording devices; fixed to 1.

methods.name: PlayoutDeviceName
methods.description: Provides the name and GUID of the playout device at a given index; only index 0 is valid.

methods.name: RecordingDeviceName
methods.description: Provides the name and GUID of the recording device at a given index; only index 0 is valid.

methods.name: SetPlayoutDevice
methods.description: Sets the playout device by index; always returns success.

methods.name: SetPlayoutDevice (WindowsDeviceType)
methods.description: Sets the playout device by Windows device type; currently unsupported.

methods.name: SetRecordingDevice
methods.description: Sets the recording device by index; always returns success.

methods.name: SetRecordingDevice (WindowsDeviceType)
methods.description: Sets the recording device by Windows device type; currently unsupported.

methods.name: PlayoutIsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if playout is available; always true.

methods.name: InitPlayout
methods.description: Initializes playout; currently a no-op.

methods.name: PlayoutIsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if playout is initialized; always true.

methods.name: RecordingIsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if recording is available; always false.

methods.name: InitRecording
methods.description: Initializes recording; currently a no-op.

methods.name: RecordingIsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if recording is initialized; always true.

methods.name: StartPlayout
methods.description: Starts audio playout; sets internal playing state to true.

methods.name: StopPlayout
methods.description: Stops audio playout; sets internal playing state to false.

methods.name: Playing
methods.description: Returns whether playout is active.

methods.name: StartRecording
methods.description: Starts audio recording; sets internal recording state to true.

methods.name: StopRecording
methods.description: Stops audio recording; sets internal recording state to false.

methods.name: Recording
methods.description: Returns whether recording is active.

methods.name: InitSpeaker
methods.description: Initializes speaker; currently unsupported.

methods.name: SpeakerIsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if speaker is initialized; always false.

methods.name: InitMicrophone
methods.description: Initializes microphone; currently a no-op.

methods.name: MicrophoneIsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if microphone is initialized; always true.

methods.name: SpeakerVolumeIsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if speaker volume control is available; always false.

methods.name: SetSpeakerVolume
methods.description: Sets speaker volume; unsupported, returns -1.

methods.name: SpeakerVolume
methods.description: Gets speaker volume; unsupported, returns -1.

methods.name: MaxSpeakerVolume
methods.description: Gets maximum speaker volume; unsupported, returns -1.

methods.name: MinSpeakerVolume
methods.description: Gets minimum speaker volume; unsupported, returns -1.

methods.name: MicrophoneVolumeIsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if microphone volume control is available; always false.

methods.name: SetMicrophoneVolume
methods.description: Sets microphone volume; unsupported, returns -1.

methods.name: MicrophoneVolume
methods.description: Gets microphone volume; unsupported, returns -1.

methods.name: MaxMicrophoneVolume
methods.description: Gets maximum microphone volume; unsupported, returns -1.

methods.name: MinMicrophoneVolume
methods.description: Gets minimum microphone volume; unsupported, returns -1.

methods.name: SpeakerMuteIsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if speaker mute is available; always false.

methods.name: SetSpeakerMute
methods.description: Sets speaker mute; unsupported, returns -1.

methods.name: SpeakerMute
methods.description: Gets speaker mute status; unsupported, returns -1.

methods.name: MicrophoneMuteIsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if microphone mute is available; always false.

methods.name: SetMicrophoneMute
methods.description: Sets microphone mute; unsupported, returns -1.

methods.name: MicrophoneMute
methods.description: Gets microphone mute status; unsupported, returns -1.

methods.name: StereoPlayoutIsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if stereo playout is available; always true.

methods.name: SetStereoPlayout
methods.description: Enables or disables stereo playout.

methods.name: StereoPlayout
methods.description: Gets stereo playout enabled status.

methods.name: StereoRecordingIsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if stereo recording is available; always true.

methods.name: SetStereoRecording
methods.description: Enables or disables stereo recording.

methods.name: StereoRecording
methods.description: Gets stereo recording enabled status.

methods.name: PlayoutDelay
methods.description: Returns the current playout delay in milliseconds; fixed at 10ms.

methods.name: BuiltInAECIsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if built-in AEC is available; always false.

methods.name: BuiltInAGCIsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if built-in AGC is available; always false.

methods.name: BuiltInNSIsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if built-in NS is available; always false.

methods.name: EnableBuiltInAEC
methods.description: Enables or disables built-in AEC; unsupported, returns -1.

methods.name: EnableBuiltInAGC
methods.description: Enables or disables built-in AGC; unsupported, returns -1.

methods.name: EnableBuiltInNS
methods.description: Enables or disables built-in NS; unsupported, returns -1.

methods.name: GetPlayoutUnderrunCount
methods.description: Returns the count of playout underruns; unsupported, returns -1.
